notes.title: Strategy Guide
notes.notes:
Hi, if anybody needs help, we've added a free walkthrough for the game. Just  click on 'View the manual' on the right side of the store page. 

It has solutions for all the puzzles so you can skip to those if you are stuck somewhere.
